description.zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

- **false**（默认值）：否。

- **true**：是。
description.en:
Specifies whether to query only the SAG instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**

description.zh:
保持时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：**3**~**65535**。

> 在智能接入网关设备和对端设备建立对等体关系时，两端设备要协商Hold Time并保持一致，如果在Hold Time内未收到对端发来的KeepAlive或Update消息，则认为BGP连接中断。
description.en:
The hold time. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: **3** to **65535**.

> When the SAG device establishes a peering connection with a peer device, the hold time of both devices must be the same. If the SAG device does not receive a keepalive or update message from the peer device within the hold time, the connection between the BGP peers is closed.

The time interval at which keep-alive packets are sent. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

description.zh:
智能接入网关设备所属自治系统编号。

取值范围：**1**~**4294967295**。
description.en:
The autonomous system number (ASN) of the SAG device.

Valid values: **1** to **4294967295**.

description.zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the SAG instance belongs.
The ID of the BGP router.
The ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance.

description.zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号。
description.en: The serial number of the SAG device.

title.zh: 修改SAG设备动态路由协议BGP的配置

descriptions.zh: 目前仅设备版本为3.4.2及以上的SCG5000和SCG5000-5G设备支持修改智能接入网关设备动态路由协议BGP的配置。
descriptions.en: You can modify the BGP configuration only of SCG5000 and SCG5000-5G devices whose version is 3.4.2 or later.
